description: Azure control-plane operations (AzureActivity table, from the subscription Activity Log).

queries.name: Operations by a caller
queries.description: Write / delete / action operations performed by one identity.
kql: | project TimeGenerated, OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue, ResourceGroup, _ResourceId, CallerIpAddress

queries.name: Resource deletions
queries.description: Successful delete operations and who performed them.
kql: | project TimeGenerated, Caller, CallerIpAddress, OperationNameValue, ResourceGroup, _ResourceId

queries.name: RBAC role assignment changes
queries.description: Role assignments created or removed at any scope.
kql: | project TimeGenerated, Caller, CallerIpAddress, OperationNameValue, SubscriptionId, ResourceGroup, _ResourceId, Properties

queries.name: Failed operations
queries.description: Operations that failed, grouped by operation and caller.
kql: | summarize Failures = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by OperationNameValue, Caller, ResourceGroup

queries.name: Activity on a resource
queries.description: All operations against resources whose ID contains the text (name, resource group, type ...).
kql: | project TimeGenerated, Caller, CallerIpAddress, OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue, _ResourceId

queries.name: Operations from an IP
queries.description: Control-plane activity coming from a caller IP address.
kql: | project TimeGenerated, Caller, OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue, ResourceGroup, _ResourceId
